candidateSelector.rationale: A context-free byte span is read once and written to a fixed-size digest specified in the pinned header. No native pointer, handle, callback, record, allocator, or engine context crosses the ABI.

evidence.text: void HashMd5(const uint8_t* buf, uint32_t buflen, uint8_t* digest);       // output is 16 bytes
void HashSha1(const uint8_t* buf, uint32_t buflen, uint8_t* digest);      // output is 20 bytes
void HashSha256(const uint8_t* buf, uint32_t buflen, uint8_t* digest);    // output is 32 bytes
void HashSha512(const uint8_t* buf, uint32_t buflen, uint8_t* digest);    // output is 64 bytes
